rationale: itnet-claude-agentic: pretrain_epochs=12, pretrain_lr=0.001, itnet_k=1, itnet_alpha=0.05, finetune_epochs=8, finetune_lr=0.0005, unet_c=32, train_n=50, val_n=5, rationale=iter-5: KNOB=pretrain_epochs: 8→12 + finetune_lr 2e-4→5e-4 + finetune_ep 5→8. iter-4 BREAKTHROUGH at k=1+c=32+α=0.05 → hr=0.0284 (SSIM 0.314, way up from 0.26 stuck ceiling). Hypothesis: at this architectural sweet spot, more pretrain + faster fine-tune should keep climbing — k=1 (single-pass) means UNet is doing all the work, so more UNet training time = more lift.
